edits.before: This is where the lane levels off. My Riposte is the whole fight — I hold it for his E (Disdain) flip, because parrying that immobilize turns the return into a stun and lets me hit a free Vital. At 6 my Grand Challenge heal zone can win a skirmish, but his R is a suppress-and-execute, so I never all-in below the threshold where Fear Beyond Death deletes me and fears my team off the reset. I want to bank my early lead into a splitpush now rather than stand still trading my Vital chunks for his percent-HP shred.
edits.after: This is where the lane levels off. Riposte is the whole fight — hold it for his E (Disdain) flip, because parrying that immobilize turns the return into a stun and frees a Vital. Disdain also shields him, so its 15s downtime at rank 3 is your only clean burst window. At 6 Grand Challenge's heal zone can win a skirmish, but never all-in below the threshold where Fear Beyond Death suppresses and executes you off a reset. Bank the early lead into a splitpush rather than trading Vital chunks for his percent-HP shred.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain: matchup-defining — His engage. Riposte it, then duel. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Urgot Disdain: 16s at rank 1, 14s at rank 5 — his engage AND a shield. Riposte it, then duel. - Your Riposte: 24s at rank 1 — never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.
